items.title: How much does a mismatch actually cost?
items.description: Reproduces the unit's own effectiveness formula. Defaults match the "Plan next sprint" task (difficulty 6) dropped into the 2pm energy trough (energy 3) from L3 — effectiveness floors at 0. Drag slot energy up to see how much energy would have been needed to make this task viable, or drag task difficulty down to see what would have fit that slot instead.
items.compute: function effectiveness(energy, difficulty) { if (energy >= difficulty) { return energy - (energy - difficulty) * 0.5; } return Math.max(0, energy - (difficulty - energy) * 1.5); } return { effectiveness: Math.round(effectiveness(params.slotEnergy, params.taskDifficulty) * 10) / 10 };
